name: default
description: Default issue delivery workflow coordinating workspace preparation, planning, implementation with self-review, landing, verification, refactoring, research recording, finalization, and cleanup.

stages.name: Workspace Lifecycle Preparation
stages.description: Prepare and validate the Git execution directory (persistent checkout, isolated feature worktree, or pinned detached worktree) required for the target logical stage.

stages.name: Stage 1 — Planning and Decomposition
stages.description: Determine whether subissues are needed and establish a filed, dispatch-ready execution plan covering root objectives and acceptance criteria.

stages.name: Stage 2.1 — Issue Implementation
stages.description: Implement required code/tests for current_issue_id satisfying all acceptance criteria under TDD red-green loop and quality standards, including pc-issue-work's required subagent self-review and repairs.

stages.name: Stage 2.2 — Landing and Merge
stages.description: Review, verify pre-merge checks, and land (merge) implementation changes into base branch.

stages.name: Stage 3 — Integrated Acceptance Verification
stages.description: Verify every original parent requirement and acceptance threshold against the integrated HEAD and combined delivery artifacts.

stages.name: Stage 4.1 — Pipeline Refactoring Audit & Plan
stages.description: Audit touched pipeline scope and generate migration ledger without modifying code or filesystem structures.

stages.name: Stage 4.2 — Pipeline Refactoring Execution
stages.description: Execute approved migration ledger atomically under scientific invariance.

stages.name: Stage 5 — Re-delivery of Pipeline Changes
stages.description: Deliver and merge refactored pipeline files.

stages.name: Stage 6 — Research Records and State Finalization
stages.description: Record final research state, artifact locations, and reproduction entry points.

stages.name: Issue Closure and Scope Reconciliation
stages.description: Execute acceptance-backed closure and inventory reconciliation across root and descendants.

stages.name: Workspace Lifecycle Cleanup
stages.description: Remove eligible worktrees and merged task branches belonging to root issue tree.

stages.name: Replanning for Scope Boundaries
stages.description: Scope-reassessment brief and replanning when any stage reports out_of_scope.
